top_3_arguments: Analyst consensus 12-month avg price target is $428.66 versus current price $459.35 (analyst_consensus_web) — i.e., the stock is already trading ~7% ABOVE the post-raise sell-side consensus PT. Even after multiple analyst raises following the Q2 beat (Benzinga 2026-05-06), the consensus has not caught up to spot. That implies muted further upside from here without yet another upward earnings revision, and earnings.days_until_next = 91 means there is no near-term catalyst to force PT walk-ups. The breakout setup at watch $461 is asking sell-side to chase, not lead.

The Q2 beat-and-raise catalyst is already priced in: stock gapped +10.72% on 2026-05-05 (recent_prices_5d open $454.50 vs prior close $400.31) and added another +5.37% on 2026-05-06 closing $459.35 — a two-day rip of ~14.7% on the news. Per the b_premarket catalyst_note, premarket on 2026-05-07 is holding flat at +0.06% with zero premarket volume data — i.e., follow-through buyers have stopped showing up the morning after the second post-earnings session. Late entry into a fully digested catalyst with no volume confirmation is the textbook 'buy the rumor, sell the news' trap; FY26 EPS guide $12.50–$13.10 is already known to the market.

Valuation/positioning is stretched on multiple measures simultaneously: daily z_score_50 = 2.89 (price ~3 stdev above 50d mean), bollinger pct_b = 1.3488 (well outside upper band 438.68 vs price 459.35), price 18.83% above sma_50 and 22.31% above sma_200, and rsi_7 = 81.56 / rsi_14 = 73.55 / rsi_21 = 75.82 (all overbought). Although these are technical, they collectively signal that valuation re-rating from the Q2 beat has been front-loaded — at $50.3B market_cap with 91 days until next catalyst, the marginal long has to underwrite multiple expansion, not just the new guide, which historically mean-reverts from these statistical extremes. Specific forward P/E vs sector median data is NOT in the facts bundle (research_gap).
